classification: execution-policy amendment raising the per-run uncertain-spend ceiling for a fresh successor; no scientific-protocol change

owner_approval.channel: Claude Code session 3cf5f3a5-3285-4fbd-9cf1-16e43f5458c5, decision menu of 2026-08-26
owner_approval.selected_option_description: One-line successor amendment, Codex-vetted before launch: same everything, per-run uncertain ceiling $2.50 (about 20 expensive-model timeouts, 4% of the $60 cap, still fully counted against it). Robust to today's provider weather. Full redo ~$7, finishes this evening.

codex_consult.verdict_summary: No blockers; $2.50 ratified. Flat ceiling preferred over a per-model sub-bound (a Qwen-specific bound would be an earlier hidden abort threshold with no protection beyond the unchanged $60 aggregate-exposure inequality). Report additions: uncertain reservations by model including held in-flight and refused admissions; booked-at-decision-time versus later billing resolution, never revising sealed history; reconcile the 12 timed-out calls against provider billing, addendum permitted; bind predecessor stop hash, owner choice, schema revision, fresh identity, exact opening aggregate; state checker_malformed was zero and unrelated.

trigger.summary: A day-long Qwen3.8 timeout burst booked ~$0.93 of worst-case reservations as uncertain, functionally tripping the $1.00 ceiling; the run was stopped at 738/1,008 rows since mid-run relaxation is forbidden.

policy.rationale: covers roughly 20 Qwen3.8-scale timeouts (3x the observed worst burst), ~35% of the expected ~$7 run cost, 4% of the $60 aggregate cap; the aggregate-exposure dispatch inequality and full counting of uncertain spend against the cap are unchanged
policy.scope: applies only to fresh successors under role-limits schema v4; historical schema revisions keep their $1.00 pin so sealed history validates under its own policy; all amendment-3 and amendment-5 rules (halt for owner review, no mid-run relaxation, no auto-successor, terminal-halt disposition and bounds) continue unchanged
policy.billing_reconciliation: the successor canary report labels every uncertain figure as booked-at-decision-time; the 12 predecessor timed-out calls are to be reconciled against Together billing records, as an addendum if billing lags, never revising sealed history

science_unchanged.statement: Protocol, roster, prompts, seeds, token limits, checker configuration, transport pins, reviewer instructions, cell plan, and every analysis gate are unchanged. All 960 gate rows are generated fresh under the new identity.

non_claims: This amendment approves the ceiling change and creation of a fresh successor identity.
Paid inference still requires a separate authorization containing the exact successor run identity.
Any further ceiling increase, row reuse, model substitution, retry-policy change, or aggregate-cap change requires new owner approval.
